5139 Trachonitis {trakh-o-nee'-tis}

源自 5138 的衍生字; 專有地名

欽定本 - Trachonitis 1; 1

特拉可尼 = 「高低不平的地區」
1) 高低不平的地區, 為強盜所居住, 西臨 Antilibanus,
   東臨 Batanaea 山脈, 北臨大馬色 (大馬士革) 版圖 (#路3:1|)
record.edic_text:
5139 Trachonitis {trakh-o-nee'-tis}

from a derivative of 5138;; n pr loc

AV - Trachonitis 1; 1

Trachonitis = "a rugged region"
1) a rough region, inhabited by robbers, situated between Antilibanus
   on the west and on the east by the mountains of Batanaea and on
   the north by the territory of Damascus
